T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). Same as the other plans. The NFS CG clocks below start at a complete requirement package.

T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). MR report, NF 1787/1787A, acquisition strategy. NFS CG limit: NFS CG 1815.12(a), Final RFP within 60 days of receiving a complete requirement package; Market Research plus Synopsis (55 days) fits it. If the RFI has not gone out, NFS CG 1805.10(a): RFI within 30 days of concept approval. At $50 million or more, a Sources Sought Notice runs a minimum of 10 business days (NFS CG 1805.11).

Regulatory minimum: RFO FAR 5.101(d), Table 5-2 (noncommercial above the SAT: presolicitation notice 15 days before solicitation issuance).  The remaining 15 days are a T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source): PSM or written plan above $10 million (NFS CG 1807.11); HQ PSM charts at least 10 working days before the meeting (NFS CG 1807.13(b)); Center RFP review (NFS CG 1815.12(c)). With a Draft RFP, NFS CG limit: NFS CG 1815.12(a), Final RFP within 45 days after the Draft RFP closes.

Regulatory minimum: RFO FAR 5.201(d), Table 5-3 (all other non-commercial acquisitions: 30 days from solicitation; R&D acquisitions: 45 days from presolicitation notice). Blackout notice on RFP release (NFS CG 1815.11(i)).

T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). Initial evaluation (SEB per NFS CG 1815.27 when complex), competitive range with a working goal of no more than three proposals (NFS 1815.204-1(b)), discussions, model contract and FPR (NFS CG 1815.25). NFS CG limit: NFS CG 1815.12(a), contract award within 120 days of proposal receipt (this plan: 87 days, 98 with ANOSCA).
T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). Cost or price and cost realism analysis, EPO support, rates and audit. The pricing review rule carries 5 days, also an assumption.

T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). SAM and FAPIIS, responsibility determination. On small business set-asides, the preaward notice (RFO FAR 15.206-1) and the five-business-day size protest window (noted in NFS CG 1805.32(b)(6)).
T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). T-Minus internal poll, same as the other plans.

T-Minus planning assumption (no regulatory source). At $30 million or more, plan 21 days: NFS CG limit: NFS CG 1805.32(b)(5), budget 10 days to 3 weeks for ANOSCA review and approval. After award: notice within 3 days (RFO FAR 15.207-2(b)); debriefing request within 3 days and debriefing within 5 days (RFO FAR 15.301-1(a)); stay window 10 days after award or 5 days after a debriefing (RFO FAR 33.105-3(b)(1)).
Regulatory limit: RFO FAR 4.302(f)(2)(ii) (complete the CAR in FPDS within three business days after contract award). A deadline, not a minimum.
